article.title: A KPI Can Improve Behavior and Still Damage the Business
article.author: OpenAI learning editor
article.why: 理解 KPI、誘因、guardrail 與 Goodhart-like behavior 的實務關係。

paragraphs.en: Key performance indicators are useful because they make priorities visible. A sales team can track conversion, a support team can track resolution time, and a product team can track retention. Problems begin when an indicator stops being a measurement tool and becomes the only target employees believe matters.
paragraphs.zh: KPI 很有用，因為它能讓優先順序被看見。銷售可以追 conversion，客服追處理時間，產品團隊追 retention。真正的問題出現在：指標從衡量工具變成員工認為唯一重要的目標。
paragraphs.ja: KPIは優先順位を見える化するために有効ですが、測定手段ではなく唯一の目標になると問題が生じます。

paragraphs.en: Imagine a customer-service center that rewards agents mainly for shorter call times. Average handling time may improve quickly. Employees learn to end calls faster, transfer difficult customers, or avoid explaining complicated issues. The KPI moves in the desired direction, yet repeat contacts and complaints may increase. The team has improved the metric while weakening the service.
paragraphs.zh: 想像一個客服中心主要用縮短通話時間來獎勵員工。平均處理時間可能很快改善，但員工也可能更快結束電話、把難題轉給別人，或不再完整解釋複雜問題。KPI 變好了，重複來電與客訴卻可能上升。也就是說，團隊改善了數字，卻損害了服務。
paragraphs.ja: 例えば、顧客対応部門が通話時間の短縮だけを強く評価すると、平均処理時間は改善するかもしれません。しかし担当者は難しい顧客を転送したり、説明を短くしたりする可能性があります。その結果、再問い合わせや苦情が増えれば、指標は改善してもサービスは悪化しています。

paragraphs.en: This pattern appears because employees respond rationally to incentives. If managers attach pay, promotion, or public ranking to one number, people naturally optimize that number. The problem is not that employees are behaving badly. The problem is that the metric captures only part of the business outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 這不是因為員工故意做壞事，而是因為人會合理回應誘因。如果薪酬、升遷或公開排名都和單一數字綁在一起，大家自然就會最佳化那個數字。真正的問題是，單一指標只捕捉了商業結果的一部分。
paragraphs.ja: これは社員が悪いのではなく、インセンティブへ合理的に反応した結果です。一つの数字が給与や評価へ強く結びつけば、その数字を最適化する行動が起こります。

paragraphs.en: A better KPI system includes a primary measure and guardrails. A support team can track handling time together with repeat-contact rate, customer satisfaction, and escalation. A marketing team can track conversions together with cancellation, fraud, or long-term value. Guardrails do not need to be equally important. Their job is to reveal whether improvement in the main measure is being purchased at an unacceptable cost elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 比較好的 KPI 設計會有 primary measure 和 guardrails。例如客服除了處理時間，也看重複聯絡率、滿意度與 escalation；行銷除了 conversion，也看取消、詐欺與長期價值。Guardrail 不一定和主要 KPI 同權重，它的功能是提醒管理者：主要指標的改善是不是靠犧牲其他重要結果換來的。
paragraphs.ja: より良いKPI設計では、主要指標とガードレールを組み合わせます。処理時間と再問い合わせ率、コンバージョンと解約率などを同時に見ることで、主要数字の改善が別の損失を生んでいないか確認できます。

paragraphs.en: Another useful practice is to review the mechanism, not only the number. If conversion rises, managers should ask why. Did targeting improve? Did pricing change? Did the denominator shrink? Was tracking modified? A good result is more trustworthy when the organization can explain the behavior that produced it.
paragraphs.zh: 另一個重要做法是理解 mechanism，而不是只看數字。如果 conversion 上升，應問原因：targeting 變好了嗎？價格改了嗎？分母縮小了嗎？tracking 定義改了嗎？能解釋行為機制的好結果，比單純一個漂亮數字更可信。
paragraphs.ja: また、数字だけでなくメカニズムを見る必要があります。コンバージョン上昇がターゲティング改善なのか、価格変更なのか、分母や計測ルールの変更なのかを確認します。

paragraphs.en: There is also a danger in having too many KPIs. A dashboard with fifty measures can make priorities less clear rather than more clear. Teams may spend more time reporting than acting. The solution is not to monitor everything but to select a small number of measures that represent the outcome, the main driver, and the most important risk.
paragraphs.zh: KPI 太多同樣有問題。五十個指標的 dashboard 可能讓優先順序更模糊，團隊也可能花太多時間報告。更好的做法是選少數能代表結果、主要驅動因素、最大風險的指標。
paragraphs.ja: 一方、KPIが多すぎても優先順位が分かりにくくなります。結果、主要ドライバー、最大リスクを表す少数の指標に絞る方が実務的です。

paragraphs.en: Targets should also be revised when behavior changes. A metric that worked during growth may become harmful during a capacity shortage. A call-time target that was useful when queues were long may be less important after staffing improves. KPIs are management tools, not permanent laws.
paragraphs.zh: KPI 也不能永久固定。成長期好用的指標，在產能不足時可能變成壞誘因。因此 KPI 是管理工具，不是永久法律。
paragraphs.ja: KPIは永久ルールではなく管理ツールです。環境や業務プロセスが変われば見直す必要があります。

paragraphs.en: The broader lesson is that a KPI should guide attention without replacing judgment. The best measurement system makes trade-offs visible. It helps employees understand not only which number should improve, but what should not be sacrificed in the process. A practical review process should compare the metric before and after changes using the same definitions. This prevents reporting changes from being mistaken for business improvement and makes the causal story easier to test.
paragraphs.zh: 真正好的衡量制度應讓 trade-off 變得可見，讓員工知道不只哪個數字要變好，也知道改善時有哪些東西不能被犧牲。實務上還應用一致定義做前後比較，避免把報告方式改變誤認成業務改善，也更容易檢驗真正的因果機制。
paragraphs.ja: 良い測定制度は、どの数字を上げるかだけでなく、何を犠牲にしてはいけないかを明確にします。また、変更前後を同じ定義で比較し、計測方法の変化を業務改善と誤認しないことも重要です。

quiz.question: Why can a KPI improve while the business gets worse?
quiz.answer: Because employees optimize the measured number even when it captures only part of the business outcome.

quiz.question: Output: name one KPI in your work and one useful guardrail.
quiz.answer: Example: conversion rate with cancellation rate as a guardrail.

interpretation.text: KPI 是誘因設計，不只是被動測量。
